notes.title: Moving To Godot
notes.notes: [p]In having many issues with unity games corrupting and unreal corrupting worse and being very unperformant we will be transfering over to godot for more compatiblity and more performance. we will soon have a launcher and the first godot build of Velocity X with what we hope is a system to choose how many cores you want to use and choose what cores handle what task[/p]

notes.title: Future Plans
notes.notes:
Hello all pre-alpha tester's I will be moving all movement code from BP to C++ for potential optimization amount of 1000-25000x faster! I do hope to get this done as soon as possible I'd say in 1.5 weeks minimum and at most 2 months till this release comes out.                  
                                           [b]Thank you for your patience and support.          -MaxiKitti[/b]
